content: {"summary":"Customers frequently report delivery errors, such as missing items or incorrect orders, and feel penalized for correcting them, citing refunds but extra delivery fees [#tk_2609400] [#tk_2780736]. Many complain about drivers refusing to deliver or taking excessive time, leading to long hold periods and frustration with customer service responses [#tk_1157047] [#tk_652704] [#tk_653515]. Issues with promo codes, scheduling, and food quality (e.g., lukewarm meals) further erode trust, with some customers receiving insufficient credits or no refunds [#tk_2629072] [#tk_2441985]. Overall, the negative sentiment highlights a need for clearer communication, fair re‑delivery policies, and improved service reliability to retain users [#tk_2609400] [#tk_1157047]"}
